edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the dispute concerning [IDENTIFY THE DISPUTE, INCLUDING ANY CASE CAPTION AND NUMBER] (the “Dispute”).

1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff USD [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) within 30 days after this Agreement has been signed by both parties, using payment instructions separately confirmed in writing. The proposed payment period is subject to client approval.

2. RELEASE. Effective upon receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date this Agreement has been signed by both parties. This release does not extend to unrelated claims or to rights or obligations under this Agreement, including the right to enforce it.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers who are subject to professional confidentiality duties or agree to maintain confidentiality; to the extent required by law, regulation, or legal process; or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Where legally permitted, a party making a legally required disclosure shall give the other party reasonable advance notice and disclose only what is required.
